sets.name: WCG CEC clinical logbook
sets.source: WCG College of Emergency Care clinical logbook, 2024/2025 edition

programmes.name: Higher Certificate in Emergency Medical Care

skills.name: Total number of patients seen and documented
Blood pressure measurement: manual sphygmomanometer - adult
Suctioning of the airway with a supraglottic/extraglottic device in place
Manual airway obstruction manoeuvres (conscious choking patient)
Use of Magill's forceps or equivalent
skills.note: REVIEW: Magill forceps counted as foreign body removal, the same HPCSA row as the choking manoeuvre

skills.name: Supraglottic airway device insertion (cardiac arrest only)
Needle cricothyroidotomy
skills.note: REVIEW: No Annexure A row; nearest is transtracheal jet ventilation (minimum 0)

skills.name: Nebulisation of medications as per scope of practice
Use of a pulse oximeter - adult
Bag valve mask manual ventilation (or equivalent)
Bag valve tube manual ventilation (or equivalent)
Non-invasive ventilation - oxygen driven (without mechanical ventilator)
skills.note: REVIEW: listed twice in DIPEMC Y3 (2 and 3); higher used

skills.name: Use of capnography/capnometry - via endotracheal tube/extra-glottic device
skills.note: REVIEW: HC minimum (5) matches HPCSA ECA confirmation device (5); for the diploma this and the confirmation-device row both count, so one intubation logged under both is counted twice

skills.name: Use of capnography/capnometry - via facemask/nasal cannula
skills.note: REVIEW: listed twice in DIPEMC Y3 (5 and 3); higher used

skills.name: Peripheral intravenous cannulation - limbs and hands
Intravenous/intraosseous fluid therapy (other than medication administration)
Wound care and application of dressing, including pressure dressings
skills.note: REVIEW: Some years include tourniquet in this row; counted as wound dressing only

skills.name: 3 lead ECG monitoring and diagnosis - adult
Cardiac arrest management - child, infant and neonate
skills.note: REVIEW: Counted as child/infant CPR; Annexure A lists neonate CPR separately (both minimum 0)

skills.name: Cervical spinal clearance using recognised techniques
Application of limb splints including traction splints
Withholding resuscitation in cases of obvious death
Interfacility transfer as per relevant scope of practice
Set up and monitoring of a patient in an incubator
Preterm labour management
skills.note: REVIEW: Annexure A tocolysis (minimum 0) is related but not equivalent

skills.name: Post-partum haemorrhage management
skills.note: REVIEW: Annexure A fundal massage (ECP minimum 1) is part of PPH care but not equivalent

skills.name: Blood pressure measurement: manual sphygmomanometer - paediatric
Use of a pulse oximeter - paediatric
3 lead ECG monitoring and diagnosis - paediatric
Mechanical infant resuscitator (BVMR/Neo Puff)
skills.note: REVIEW: listed twice in DIPEMC Y3 (3 and 2); higher used
